title: KY PSC Order — Case No. 2020-00154: ELECTRONIC MARTIN COUNTY WATER DISTRICT MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION MONITORING PURSUANT TO KRS 278.250

CASE NO.

COMMISSION STAFF’S NOTICE OF INFORMAL CONFERENCE 
Commission Staff hereby schedules an informal conference on May 21, 2026, from 
2 p.m. to 3 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time, to take place via video conference link, to discuss 
information contained in the monthly packet prepared for the April 2026 Martin County 
Water District board meeting. 
Commission Staff will contact participants by electronic mail to provide details for 
joining the conference by video link.
